profile.headline: Software Engineer, AWS Developer | Bachelor of Science in Web Development
profile.summary:
At Tata Consultancy Services, our team engineers robust cloud solutions, leveraging my expertise in CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible to orchestrate efficient deployment of serverless environments. Developing with the MERN stack, we create microservices that are as resilient as they are scalable. My role centers on transforming intricate business requirements into tangible, high-performing cloud infrastructures.

With a solid educational foundation, holding a Bachelor of Science in Web Development from Bellevue University, my journey weaves through an intricate tapestry of Systems Design, Cloud Development, and Solutions Architecture. The satisfaction of seeing our collective efforts materialize in the shape of responsive, dynamic, and interactive web applications drives my commitment to innovation, quality, and continuous learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer cloud solutions to meet business requirements. Develop
infrastructure as code using CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible to deploy testing environments. Develop microservices using the MERN stack.

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher
positions.description: Emphasis on responsive dynamic designs for cross-platform development. Students are introduced to front-end manipulation, and learn how to create interactive web applications with some JavaScript implementation.

positions.title: Inventory Control Specialist
positions.description: Read customer emails and handled database alterations to satisfy shipments. Used lists on SAP software to complete tasks. Researched pick history on product to create location history documentation so other workers can search for lost material. Created daily reports on spreadsheets to record keep our shifts daily output.

positions.title: Marker/Grader
positions.description: Graded students class work in a CS 11 class that consisted of students studying the basics of computer science.
